description: The rows themselves: every charge, or one commitment's, optionally inside a window or only paid / only unpaid — each with its amount, paid state, the day the money moved, what backs it, and its note. A charge behind today reads paid whatever its row says. Transfers are listed with direction "transfer" and summed apart, never in total; money in is read by naming its commitment. This is the ledger; nothing here is computed. Amounts are per-currency and never converted, blended, or amortised.
name: charges
title: List charges
